# Uuid Ai MCP

> UUID, ULID, and NanoID generation by MEOK AI Labs

`uuid-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install uuid-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx uuid-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `generate_uuid` — Generate one or more UUIDs. Supports versions 1, 3, 4, and 5.
- `parse_uuid` — Parse and validate a UUID string, extracting all components.
- `generate_ulid` — Generate ULID(s) - Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers.
- `generate_nanoid` — Generate NanoID(s) - compact URL-friendly unique identifiers.
- `batch_generate` — Batch generate identifiers of a specified type. Efficient for bulk operations.
